method: Static parse of every page.js under public/framework (excludes core/new/** and ai/<date>/**, which are declared-but-dynamic or off-limits by CLAUDE.md). Each file's own exported config object is located precisely (export default new X(...)) and scanned at bracket-depth 0, so example code inside content()/initialize() bodies is never mistaken for a real field. children:/overview:/methods:/properties:/notes:/files: give the edges; api/docs/files become non-visual tab nodes when non-empty; overview: demos are always visual (Doc auto-catalogs its Overview) and cost one real click each despite the Overview tab itself costing zero. An edge out of a plain Page is visual only when that page's own content()/initialize() body calls this.previews()/this.walls()/this.catalog()/demo.exhibit() (checked with string literals stripped, so prose that merely mentions the method name cannot false-positive). A Doc's OWN declared children: (extra top tabs, e.g. a 'guide' page) are never visual — every declared child becomes a tab in Doc.bar(), not a card.
